title: feat(console): ownership queues in the Console — two-source queue pickers, Claim on a queued record, an In-a-queue list filter, and the authoring guide (ADR-0142)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB8rwmX7EbpJUiWbaWPRGoeg)_

Part of #25769

Ruling-ref: ADR-0142 accepted by the maintainer's merge of #25816 (2026-10-26T06:44:50Z); this PR carries its Execution plan items 3 (Console) and 4 (docs). Item 2, the HotCRM STOPGAP delete, remains on its own lane, so #25769 stays open.
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none here. `skills/**` is out of scope (Tier H); the skills-side teaching of queues and assignment rules is owed to #26475.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Console 补上工单队列的三处界面——审批人与分享接收人的队列选择器同时列出包声明的队列和组织自建的 `sys_queue`;坐在队列里的记录头部出现「认领」,只在服务端 explain 对 transfer 回答 `queue_claim: admits` 时显示，点击即发 `{ owner_id: 自己 }`;列表工具栏新增「在队列中」筛选(`owner_id` 为空且 `queue` 有值)。另加一篇作者指南 `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx`。
- 为什么改:ADR-0142 已接受(#25816 合并),服务端在 #26337 落地，但 Console 仍是占位文本框，没有认领入口，也看不到停在队列里的记录;执行计划第 3、4 项要求补齐。
- 风险与回滚:不改 spec、不改服务端;认领失败关闭(没有答复就不显示按钮),输掉并发认领的 409 明确提示「别人先认领了」;筛选只在对象带注入的 `queue` 系统列时出现。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/queueClaim.ts`、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`(认领)、`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`(筛选)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowReferenceField.tsx`(审批人选择器)。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/queueClaim-25769.test.tsx packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.queueSittingFilter-25769.test.tsx packages/fields/src/widgets/RecipientPickerField.queue-25769.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FlowReferenceField.queuePicker-25769.test.tsx`,预期 4 个文件 36 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无，席位落地

## What changes

- **Queue pickers read both sources (ADR-0142 D6/D7).** `@object-ui/fields` gains `mergeQueueCandidates` / `queueCandidateLabel` (one list by machine name, declared first, ordered by name) and a `RECIPIENT_REGISTRY_AND_RECORD_KINDS` table. `RecipientPickerField` lists a `queue` recipient from the metadata store's `queue` items and `sys_queue` rows (`find('sys_queue', { $top: 500, $orderby: { name: 'asc' } })`) and stores the name; with either reader missing it keeps the text input. The read face (`refLabelDirectory`) names a stored queue the same way. In `@object-ui/app-shell`, `FlowReferenceField` replaces the "until the console's two-source queue picker lands" placeholder with `TwoSourcePickCell`, driven by the binding the server publishes (`registry-and-data`, or the bundled spec's when nothing is published); `json-schema-to-fields` now keeps a whole `registry-and-data` binding instead of dropping it. A server that publishes anything else for `queue` keeps the old text cell.
- **Claim (ADR-0142 D3/D4).** `@object-ui/plugin-detail` adds `queueClaim.ts`: `recordSitsInQueue` (owner empty and a queue named), `useQueueClaimOffered` (asks `POST /api/v1/security/explain { operation: 'transfer' }` and offers only on a `queue_claim` rule with `effect: 'admits'`; fails closed) and `claimQueuedRecord` (sends `{ owner_id: <self> }` through `update`; a `409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE` is `taken`). `RecordDetailView` adds a `sys_claim` header action on that answer, toasts claimed / taken / refused, and invalidates the record.
- **"In a queue" filter (ADR-0142 D3).** `@object-ui/plugin-list` `ListView` offers a toolbar toggle only when the served object definition carries the injected `queue` column (`system: true`). Pressed, it AND-s `['owner_id','is_empty',true]` and `['queue','is_not_empty',true]` (lowered to `$empty`) into the fetch, the self-querying views and the export. Empty means null or `''` on both columns, as the explain engine and the assignment seam read it.
- **i18n.** `fields.recipient.selectQueue`, `detail.claim` / `claimed` / `claimTaken` / `claimFailed`, `list.sittingInQueue` / `sittingInQueueHint` in all 10 locales; `engine.inspector.reference.pickFromQueues` in the studio en/zh namespaces.
- **Docs (plan item 4).** New `content/docs/automation/queues-and-assignment-rules.mdx`: declaring a queue and an assignment rule, the `load` requirement, what a parked record is and who sees it, how a claim is spelled (and release / move), and that a queue is not a messaging audience. Linked from `automation/index.mdx`, `automation/approvals.mdx`, `permissions/sharing-rules.mdx` (the recipient table gains its `queue` row) and `permissions/rls.mdx` (`current_user.queues`). The generated `references/automation/assignment-rule.mdx` is not touched; `scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json` regenerated by its own `--write`.
- Changeset `.changeset/25769-console-queue-affordances.md`: patch on `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Tests

- `RecipientPickerField.queue-25769.test.tsx` (7): the merge helper's order, collisions and shapes; the picker's two requests, both sources listed and a shadowing row hidden, the stored name, one failing source still offering the other, and the text input with no store (no `find` call).
- `FlowReferenceField.queuePicker-25769.test.tsx` (9): `json-schema-to-fields` keeps a whole binding and drops a half one; `twoSourceFor` precedence; with an adapter, `metaList('queue')` and `find('sys_queue', …)`, both options listed, the chosen name committed; a stored name neither lists shown flagged `(not found)`; manual entry and back; no adapter reads nothing; another published binding keeps the text cell.
- `queueClaim-25769.test.tsx` (12): sits-in-queue for owned / unowned / no queue; `queueClaimAdmitted` true only on `queue_claim` + `admits` (not a visible transfer, not `queue_membership`, not a malformed answer); the hook's POST body, no button on `neutral`, a non-OK or thrown probe, no probe for a non-sitting record or an unknown user; the write is `{ owner_id }` only, a 409 is `taken`, a 403 is `refused` with its error.
- `ListView.queueSittingFilter-25769.test.tsx` (8): `objectHasOwnershipQueue` (map and array forms, a non-system `queue` refused); the two triples pinned as `is_empty` / `is_not_empty`; `buildEffectiveFilter` with and without the conditions; the toggle renders on an injected column and its press and release change the fetch `$filter`; no toggle without the injected column.

## Acceptance notes

- An unowned record with no `queue` is claimable on the server by anyone with a positive sharing basis (D4), but the Console offers Claim only on a record that sits in a queue, as plan item 3 names it.
- The pickers and the read face cap `sys_queue` at 500 rows by name, as the record pickers do.
- The "In a queue" toggle is ephemeral toolbar state, not saved with the view.
- The approver read face (the label shown for a stored `queue` approver outside the editor) is unchanged and shows the name.
- No dogfood or live-boot leg: the harness's queue rows belong to the server PR (#26337); this PR's legs are the component tests above.

## Verification

Head `e3e83a00`, merge base `ae16687a`. Every locked run is read from its `VERDICT command-exit` line.

- New tests: 4 files, 36 tests, all pass (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- Touched suites under `os-verify-lock`: `plugin-detail` + `i18n` + the `fields` recipient/queue files, 416 files, 4361 passed / 31 skipped; the app-shell scope (`FlowReferenceField*`, `json-schema-to-fields*`, `flow-node-config*`, `utils/approverValueSources*`, `widget-ref-cells`, `RecordDetailView*`), 103 files, 945 passed / 1 skipped; `plugin-list` whole, 168 files, 1675 passed. Each `VERDICT command-exit 0`. A single combined run of all of them hit the session's 30-minute limit and was split, not narrowed.
- `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` + `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) of `@object-ui/fields`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-list`, `i18n`, `app-shell`: each `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 78 commands, all `exit 0`. Four were run twice. `check:role-word` found `role:` in the new guide; the wording was fixed in `4dde047e`, and it exits 0. Three `scripts/` tests timed out at 15s while the locked suites shared the box; on a quiet box, the two files exit 0 and the whole `scripts/` run passes 5019 tests with 2 skipped. `check:skill-examples` exited 3 because `client-react` was not built; after that build it exits 0. `check:type-check-debt` exited 3 because it got no turn on the lock; run under the lock, it exits 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 78 derived, 78 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- The `@object-ui/plugin-form` write census (`affordanceGrantMap-12082`, red on CI at `58d26514`) grades the two new write sites: `claimQueuedRecord` is a write helper, and the record page's `handleClaim` is `outOfFamily`, because a claim is admitted from the row's own sharing verdict, not an object grant, and is offered only on the explain answer. Run locked: 55/55 pass, and the `plugin-form` type-check gives `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Docs: `check:doc-authoring`, `check-adr-links`, `check-doc-frontmatter`, and `check:docs-audit-scope` exit 0. Every new `/docs/…` link resolves to a page in the tree. `Check Documentation Links` (lychee) runs in CI.
